source.text:
Fix general-format notation selection after rounding: `%.3g` of `999.9` now yields `1e+03`, and `0.00009999` yields `0.0001`. Bound trailing-zero normalization by coefficient size to prevent scale-driven work and midpoint overflow; derive scientific exponents without expanding fractional zeros.

Validation: default tests, BSON race tests and vet passed; added carry/tie/extreme-scale regressions and standard fmt comparisons on exact binary rationals. Large-scale scientific formatting: \~827 KB → 80 B/op; normalization: \~317 µs → 117 ns/op (Go 1.26.6, M5 Max).

Stack: [#8](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/8>) → [#9](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/9>) → [#10](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/10>) → [#11](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/11>). Merge in this order. [#12](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/12>) (validator cache) was withdrawn; validation retains direct parsing.

Layer 1/4; base: `main`. This is the first layer.  
Next: [#9](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/9>).

samples.translatedText:
修复舍入后的通用格式记数法选择：`%.3g` 的 `999.9` 现在会得到 `1e+03`，而 `0.00009999` 会得到 `0.0001`。按系数大小限制尾随零规范化，以避免由尺度驱动的运算和中点溢出；计算科学计数法指数时不展开小数零。

验证：默认测试、BSON 竞态测试和 vet 均已通过；新增了进位/中点/极端尺度回归测试，以及对精确二进制有理数的标准 fmt 比较。大尺度科学计数法格式化：\~827 KB → 80 B/op；规范化：\~317 µs → 117 ns/op（Go 1.26.6，M5 Max）。

依赖栈： [#8](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/8>) → [#9](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/9>) → [#10](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/10>) → [#11](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/11>)。按此顺序合并。[#12](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/12>)（验证器缓存）已撤回；验证仍采用直接解析。

第 1/4 层；基础：`main`。这是第一层。  
下一步：[#9](<https://github.com/exc-works/decimal/pull/9>)。
